- [Research draft with exact P1–P6 dispositions](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M01-A/control/research-q1/draft.md>)

The q1 draft favors proving a Kotlin/Room offline-first baseline, while retaining PowerSync and CouchDB as conditional alternatives. It also records the main implementation risks: conflict policy, photo lifecycle, selective access, export, and migration. Source research covered [Android offline-first guidance](https://developer.android.com/topic/architecture/data-layer/offline-first), [PowerSync self-hosting](https://docs.powersync.com/intro/self-hosting), and [CouchDB’s reported attachment replication issue](https://github.com/apache/couchdb/issues/5422).

No app or device runtime checks were available; validation items are explicitly proposed, not reported as executed. I did not read parent, counterpart, evaluator, or history material. Usage/billing remains unobserved (`null`).
